title: D&D 3.5e Skill Definition
description: Schema for SkillDefinition content files. Each file is a JSON array of skills. Self-contained for LLM use. Note: The SkillDefinition type is not yet implemented in the C# engine — skills are currently referenced by string ID only.

id.description: Unique skill ID in snake_case. Must match the IDs used in classSkills on HDDrivers. Subspecialty skills use 'skill_subtype' format (e.g., 'knowledge_arcana', 'craft_alchemy', 'perform_sing').

keyAbility.description: The ability score used for this skill's checks.

trainedOnly.description: True if the skill can only be used with at least 1 rank. False if usable untrained.

armorCheckPenalty.description: True if the armor check penalty applies to this skill.

parentSkill.description: For subspecialty skills, the base skill category ID (e.g., 'knowledge' for 'knowledge_arcana'). Null for standalone skills.

description.description: Brief description of what the skill does.

synergies.description: Synergy bonuses granted by 5+ ranks in this skill.

targetSkillId.description: The skill ID that receives the synergy bonus.

condition.description: Optional condition for the synergy (e.g., 'when acting in disguise' for Bluff → Disguise).
